name: @office/actions
description: Office action gateway (OFF-017): THE typed command execution chokepoint every consequential action (human, agent, app, adapter) passes through (freeze A8). ActionDescriptor registry with fail-closed four-class classification (read / reversible / approval-required / prohibited; unknown commands are prohibited by default), deny-by-default authorization + policy + A4 evidence/confidence gates BEFORE any handler invocation, idempotency-key deduplication (duplicate action keys return the original outcome with no duplicate effects and a duplicate-observed audit event), approval-required actions routed into the workflow/approval engine (never executed without the completed approval), and the gateway's own audit trail through the EventSink port. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/persistence (the SqlExecutor type of the EventSink port), and @office/workflows (the approval engine the approval-required class routes into).
